sentences.text: Through: Ms. Nazia Fazal, Advocate vice  Mrs. Monika Kohli, Sr. AAG
Coram: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SANJAY DHAR, JUDGE  ORDER 11.03.2024 01.

The petitioners have inter alia challenged draft award dated 16.05.2011 and the acquisition proceedings initiated by the respondents pursuant to notification under Section 4(1) of J&K Land Acquisition Act issued on 01.05.2008.
The petitioners, however, have not given the particulars of the land owned/possessed by them, which is subject matter the impugned proceedings.
02. The petitioner are directed to furnish particulars and measurements of the land owned and possessed by them, which is subject matter of the impugned acquisition proceedings.
Needful shall be done by them by filing an affidavit in this regard by next date of hearing.

03. The respondents in their reply have taken a stand that the impugned acquisition proceedings stand concluded, inasmuch as, the final award has been passed by the Collector on 16.05.2011 well within the period of issuance of the declaration under Section 6 of the Land Acquisition Act.
It has been further submitted that whole of the compensation stands paid to the petitioners.

04. In order to ascertain the merits of the contentions raised by the learned counsel for the parties,
